remaining_nonclaims: No numeric approval latency budget or tripwire is established by one host's pre/post runs.

Client commit wait is polling-quantized and includes synthetic chain cadence; it is not exact commit latency.
CPU deltas are process-wide rather than commit-exclusive.
Wallet proof/resolution measures exact state query and match, not proof generation.
The admitted-anchor optimization relies on induction over locally admitted predecessors; cold and recovery paths retain full verification.
The result does not qualify JMT, authorize batching or partitioning, move M04.6 ownership, or broaden cryptographic and protocol claims.
The deterministic blocking merge lane and scheduled release-qualification soak remain separate and unchanged.
